comment: M14e deploy-ledger vectors (CONCEPT_standort_ledger_v2, Thomas 07.11). reader_cases: hero-entry table law, hand-pinned. leash_cases: C4 friend leash pinned as law relations + recorded seed-chain pins (deploy_ledger_record.json). space_cases: HeroDeployed/Spawn-dp through the real feed path; dump/canon recorded for review, spatial claims hand-pinned.

reader_cases.name: exact_match_multi
reader_cases.comment: Multi-field mission: both entries in table order, guid@section.

reader_cases.name: junk_rows_and_blank_fields_fail_closed
reader_cases.comment: A junk row drops the row; a blank guid or section drops the entry; one clean entry survives.

leash_cases.name: cross_section_tie_leash_wins
leash_cases.comment: Both candidates tier 1 (anchor lives in a third section) -> cross-section tie -> the friendly section wins BEFORE the seed chain. Absolute no-leash winner is the recorded seed-chain pin.

leash_cases.name: tier_primat_anchor_beats_friend
leash_cases.comment: Anchor section carries dp-A (tier 0, NOT own); dp-B is own but tier 1. The leash never crosses the anchor tier - dp-A wins with AND without the leash.

leash_cases.name: intra_section_distance_outranks_leash
leash_cases.comment: Same anchored section: closer dp-A wins on intra-section distance (tie never opens) even though the FRIENDLY group stands next to the far dp-B.

leash_cases.name: leash_neutral_when_both_sections_own
leash_cases.comment: Both candidates own -> the tie stays, the seed chain decides -> pick MUST equal the no-leash winner (recorded pin).

leash_cases.name: empty_own_sections_is_the_legacy_line
leash_cases.comment: ownSections present but EMPTY (no located friendlies): the leash is inert, pick equals the no-leash winner for every (seed, round).

space_cases.name: m14e_entry_confirms_edge
space_cases.comment: THE payoff vector: single blue field anchors the hero at round 1 (printed setup fact). Round 2's window STARTS on that anchor; the first real observation in sec-B CONFIRMS the sec-A->sec-B edge. Without the entry (control case) the same history knows nothing.

space_cases.name: m14e_control_no_entry_no_edge
space_cases.comment: Control: same window history WITHOUT the HeroDeployed event -> no anchor at window start -> no crossing -> no edge recorded. Pins that the confirmation in the case above really comes from the ledger entry.

space_cases.name: m14e_multi_field_set_no_claim
space_cases.comment: Two blue fields ("half/half"): both section NODES exist for belief math, but NO single-section anchor while the set has two members (Thomas decision 3).

space_cases.name: m14e_set_collapses_to_one
space_cases.comment: Two fields in the SAME section: the distinct-section set has one member -> anchor allowed.

space_cases.name: m14e_no_field_mission_inert
space_cases.comment: Mission without a blue field (measured 5/138): nothing is emitted, nothing is anchored - identical to the pre-M14e world.

space_cases.name: m14e_spawn_dp_section_seed
space_cases.comment: Spawn with the ledger's dp+section: the group's belief seeds on ITS OWN entry section (not the kandidatenmenge). deploySeeds deliberately names a DIFFERENT section - the Spawn's own section payload outranks it (existing S-C priority law).
